site_name: Land adjacent to Constable House, Adelaide Road
evidence_slice: Camden Council's Local Plan examination Matter 10 statement identifies Site Allocation C27, Land adjacent to Constable House, Adelaide Road. It states that C27 was identified through the Gypsy and Traveller Site Identification Study (EB12), that the boundary reflects the extent of land identified in that study and the Council's understanding of the development opportunity, and that the site is expected to come forward in the first five years of the Plan period (2026/27-2030/31). The statement records Council ownership, says land assembly is not required, says the Council would be responsible for bringing forward delivery, and proposes no modifications to the allocation.
